input.command: cd /workspace && cat dotenv/parser.py && echo "=====TESTS=====" && cat tests/test_acceptance.py

cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream
cases = [
 "X=value   \n",
 "Y=word # comment\n",
 "Z=has#hash\n",
 "A=two  spaces\n",
 "B= trail and # comment  \n",
 "C=\n",
 "D=  spaced  \n",
 "E=foo\t#\tcomment\n",
 "F=foo#notcomment\n",
 "G=foo #c1 #c2\n",
]
for c in cases:
    rows=list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(c)))
    print(repr(c), "->", [(r.key, r.value, r.error) for r in rows])
EOF
echo "--- tests ---"
cd /workspace && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -20; python -m unittest -v 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /workspace && git status 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; cat dotenv/version.py; grep -rn "strip\|split\|#" dotenv/main.py | head -30
cd /workspace && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -30
